covered.label: Subway (Red, Orange, Blue, Green B/C/D/E, Mattapan)
Commuter Rail
covered.detail: Live MBTA V3 predictions at the five stations where it meets the subway - South Station, North Station, Forest Hills, Braintree, JFK/UMass. Live-only: a train only appears once MBTA is actually predicting it, never backfilled from the printed timetable.

partial.label: CapeFlyer
partial.detail: Walk-up, no reservation required, but MBTA's live predictions feed carries no CapeFlyer route, so it can't be shown even though it's in scope.

notCovered.label: Amtrak (Acela, Northeast Regional, Lake Shore Limited)
notCovered.detail: Excluded - booking a seat is compulsory.

notCovered.label: Silver Line, buses, ferries, Massport shuttles

stations: 125 subway stations, plus MBTA Commuter Rail live predictions at 5 of them.
notes: Park Street is the Red x Green hub; Downtown Crossing, Gov't Center, State, South Station, North Station and Haymarket are separate stations, not the same stop as Park Street.
